# 2109. Adding Spaces to a String

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def addSpaces(self, s, spaces):
        """
        :type s: str
        :type spaces: List[int]
        :rtype: str
        """
        ans = []
        p = 0
        for i, c in enumerate(s):
            if p < len(spaces) and i == spaces[p]:
                ans.append(" ")
                p += 1    
            ans.append(c)
        return "".join(ans)
```
